package trafficcontrol

import (
	"github.com/sagernet/sing/common/bufio"
	"io"
	"net"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"
)

func TestGhajarTCPCountsActualPayload(t *testing.T) {
	m := NewManager()
	a, b := net.Pipe()
	defer a.Close()
	defer b.Close()
	up, down := m.ghajarCounters("data", new(atomic.Int64), new(atomic.Int64))
	c := bufio.NewInt64CounterConn(a, up, down)
	done := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { _, e := b.Write([]byte("upload")); done <- e }()
	data := make([]byte, 6)
	if _, e := io.ReadFull(c, data); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	if e := <-done; e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	go func() { _, e := io.ReadFull(b, make([]byte, 8)); done <- e }()
	if _, e := c.Write([]byte("download")); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	if e := <-done; e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	u, d := m.GhajarUsage()
	if u != 6 || d != 8 {
		t.Fatalf("got %d %d", u, d)
	}
	m.Clear()
	u, d = m.GhajarUsage()
	if u != 6 || d != 8 {
		t.Fatal("history clearing reset meter")
	}
}
func TestGhajarProbeDoesNotConsumeQuota(t *testing.T) {
	m := NewManager()
	up, down := m.ghajarCounters("ghajar-vault-probe", new(atomic.Int64), new(atomic.Int64))
	for _, p := range up {
		p.Add(100)
	}
	for _, p := range down {
		p.Add(200)
	}
	u, d := m.GhajarUsage()
	if u != 0 || d != 0 {
		t.Fatal("probe charged")
	}
}
func TestGhajarCountersIncludeConcurrentConnections(t *testing.T) {
	m := NewManager()
	for i := 0; i < 2000; i++ {
		up, down := m.ghajarCounters("data", new(atomic.Int64), new(atomic.Int64))
		for _, p := range up {
			p.Add(3)
		}
		for _, p := range down {
			p.Add(5)
		}
	}
	u, d := m.GhajarUsage()
	if u != 6000 || d != 10000 {
		t.Fatal("lost connection totals")
	}
}

func TestGhajarFreezeRejectsNewIO(t *testing.T) {
 m:=NewManager()
 m.ghajarUpload.Add(12);m.ghajarDownload.Add(34)
 up,down:=m.GhajarFreeze()
 if up!=12 || down!=34 { t.Fatal("final counters") }
 if m.ghajarBeginIO() { t.Fatal("I/O admitted after freeze") }
}
